questions.question: Verify the historical name of the Moscow Pedagogical Institute in 1918 and the academy that established the seminar in 1959: the text names the USSR academy, while the biography also refers to the RSFSR academy. Check the exact honorary title.

localizations.source: Verify the historical name of the Moscow Pedagogical Institute in 1918 and the academy that established the seminar in 1959: the text names the USSR academy, while the biography also refers to the RSFSR academy. Check the exact honorary title.
localizations.ru: Уточнить исторические названия Московского педагогического института в 1918 году и академии, при которой создан семинар в 1959 году: в тексте указана АПН СССР, тогда как в биографии есть АПН РСФСР. Проверить точное название почётного звания.

questions.resolution: The Ushinsky Library of the Russian Academy of Education confirms the P. G. Shelaputin Higher Pedagogical Institute, the 1959 seminar and its exact title; the Academy’s history confirms the RSFSR academy’s reorganization as the USSR academy on 1 August 1966. The honour is corrected to Honoured Scientist of the Russian SFSR (1964).

questions.question: Establish a public source and the author of the historical portrait of Ivan Andronov; for the 1957 Arithmetic cover, identify the specific edition and publisher and confirm the basis for reproduction. “Illustration accompanying the text” supplies none of this provenance.

localizations.source: Establish a public source and the author of the historical portrait of Ivan Andronov; for the 1957 Arithmetic cover, identify the specific edition and publisher and confirm the basis for reproduction. “Illustration accompanying the text” supplies none of this provenance.
localizations.ru: Установить публичный первоисточник и автора исторического портрета И. К. Андронова, а для обложки «Арифметики» 1957 года — конкретное издание, издателя и подтверждённое основание воспроизведения; формулировка «Иллюстрация к материалу» этих сведений не содержит.

questions.question: Verify the year Ivan Andronov became head of department: the Ushinsky Library of the Russian Academy of Education and a 1984 Mathematics at School article give 1931, while Mathedu gives 1933; choose a documented date and align RU/EN.

localizations.source: Verify the year Ivan Andronov became head of department: the Ushinsky Library of the Russian Academy of Education and a 1984 Mathematics at School article give 1931, while Mathedu gives 1933; choose a documented date and align RU/EN.
localizations.ru: Сверить год назначения И. К. Андронова заведующим кафедрой: Библиотека им. Ушинского РАО и статья «Математика в школе» (1984) указывают 1931 год, Mathedu — 1933; выбрать датировку с доказательством и согласовать RU/EN.
